html:
Detailed Itinerary Of The Tour

  • 8:00 AM: Our Hanoi Bicycle Tour Team will pick you up from your hotel, Airbnb, or homestay and take you to our bicycle store where you can choose a bike that suits you. After getting comfortable with your bicycle and receiving a safety briefing, we’ll begin our ride.
  • Our guide will lead you as we leave the busy city and head onto the back roads, dirt trails, and rural countryside paths. The first stop will be Long Bien Bridge, where you will enjoy stunning panoramic views of Hanoi city and the Red River. Cycling across the middle of the bridge, you’ll have the chance to observe the vast island below, where local farmers work, providing a spectacular view of both the city and the river.
  • We’ll then continue cycling through several villages and rural areas, immersing ourselves in the serene countryside. Pedal through bright green rice paddies while stopping to visit local cottages and marvel at the vast expanses of farmland. During this journey, you’ll also meet local residents, and our guide will lead you past the most picturesque and fascinating landscapes in the Red River Delta.
  • In addition to the cycling, we will visit Co Loa Citadel, a significant historical site dating back to 257 BC, offering insight into the country’s ancient history.
  • Our next stop will be a local market, where you can experience the vibrant atmosphere, followed by a visit to a fruit farm where you’ll have the chance to pick and enjoy tropical fruits.
  • We will then enjoy lunch at a Vietnamese family’s home, where they will cook and serve a delicious traditional meal.
  • After lunch, we will continue cycling through the villages and stop to visit local families. This provides an opportunity to meet the locals, learn about their farming practices, and understand their daily lives.
  • We will then ride along the Red River bank, heading back to Hanoi, with an expected arrival time around 4:00 PM – 4:30 PM.

Tour Includes

  • Professional English-speaking guide
  • Quality mountain bike provided
  • Free pick-up and drop-off service
  • All entry fees + free water during the tour
  • Lunch at a local family home
  • For groups of 3 or more, we provide a backup guide to ensure the safety and security of the group
outline: Day 1: Hanoi Bicycle Tours Explore The Red River Delta
